from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Parsed information from a single judgment document relevant to the case cause."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    cause_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document mentioning the cause")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase]
